info.name: goVerifEye API - Production
info.description:
Generated from the deployed OpenAPI contract. Swagger: https://goverifeye-api.onrender.com/docs

Set the secret password locally in Postman; it is intentionally not stored in this file. Login captures access and refresh tokens automatically. Requests inherit bearer authentication unless the OpenAPI operation is public.

request.description: Sends a six-digit OTP to the supplied email address. Use the returned challenge ID for tracking; the code is delivered through email.

exec: pm.test('Response time is below 10 seconds', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000); });
if (pm.response.code < 300) { const v = pm.response.json().data ?? pm.response.json(); if (v.challengeId) pm.collectionVariables.set('challengeId', v.challengeId); }

request.description: Submit the opaque challenge ID returned by the OTP request endpoint and the six-digit code received by email.
